in_sanskrit.name: Chethan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Self-existent
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chethan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'chit' meaning consciousness or 'chetana' meaning self-existent, self-conscious, or self-awakened. In Hindu mythology, Chethan can refer to various deities and spirits.
